hook.name: ProbabilisticFeeCollector
hook.description: Attempts to collect fees from a designated liquidity position (by NFT ID) after swaps. On blocks where block.number % triggerModulo == 0, it calls DECREASE_LIQUIDITY (with zero liquidity delta) and TAKE_PAIR via the position manager to harvest accumulated fees to a fixed STATIC_COLLECTOR address. The NFT ID and trigger modulo are configurable by the STATIC_COLLECTOR.
